description: This Java interface defines methods for accessing granted and revoked subject IDs within an enforcer context, related to specific resources and permissions. It is marked as deprecated and suggests using an alternative interface.

classes.name: EffectedSubjectIds
classes.description: Interface for retrieving sets of granted and revoked subject IDs related to resource permissions, deprecated in favor of EffectedSubjects.

methods.name: getGranted
methods.description: Returns the set of subject IDs that are granted within the specified scope.

methods.name: getRevoked
methods.description: Returns the set of subject IDs that are revoked within the specified scope.
